superseded_inquiry_history.author_question: I want to understand what the memory economy is doing for the reader, not only how the mechanism works. Why does it matter that every accurate map costs someone a memory? What does it make possible emotionally and structurally that a conventional mystery about a hidden massacre could not? Please explain its narrative function in the wonder-to-dread movement.
superseded_inquiry_history.analysis:
The memory economy matters because it makes accuracy stop being neutral. Every accurate survey moves a memory out of a person and into the map, so wonder at accuracy is always paid for by someone. The story invites the reader to want the survey to succeed, which implicates the reader in the loss. The first missing memory is the hinge that turns the wonder of the strange coast into dread by making the cost personal.

A conventional mystery treats the massacre as a past crime and the solution as a gain. Here the same mechanism explains how the archive was made and hidden, so the evidence of the crime is itself a costly product. Emotionally, curiosity and fear fuse, so the wish for truth becomes entangled with fear of what it will erase, and dread grows from recognition rather than shock. Structurally, the cost climbs from civic history into the identity of the surveyor, forcing a choice between an accurate record that wounds and a merciful omission that protects belonging. The final choice is both a solution and an intimate loss, which is where mystery and horror converge.

directions.distinguishing_factor: Changes whether the cost can be recovered, which no other direction changes.
directions.mechanism: Each transferred memory is recorded by the map as a debt that a later survey can repay, so the engine becomes an economy of restitution rather than of irreversible loss.
directions.title: Restorable survey debt
directions.tradeoff: The recorded earned_hope summary depends on a partial remembrance that cannot be restored, so this direction would have to revise that node and the choice of maps together.

directions.consequence: The complicity theme moves from the surveyor's own past into the Guild's selection practice, and the dread becomes class-structured rather than universal.
directions.distinguishing_factor: Changes who pays and why, while keeping the cost irreversible.

directions.tradeoff: It can displace the founding massacre behind a social critique, so the mystery's central question may need a separate anchor.
